AI Receptionist That Books Jobs into Jobber (2026)

"Integrates with Jobber" can mean three different things. Some tools book the visit straight onto your schedule, some create a client or request through Zapier, and some just text you a summary. Here's what each one does, going by the vendor's own docs.

← All solutions · Integrations checked Oct 15, 2026 against vendor docs

🧭 Quick decision rules

  • You want the visit on your calendar, not just a lead→ Jobber Receptionist or Smith.ai. Both book through your Jobber online booking setup.
  • You're fine reviewing requests first→ Dialzara's Zap creates a Jobber request you can approve and schedule.
  • Budget is the main thing→ Upfirst starts at $24.95/mo for 30 calls; Dialzara at $29/mo for 60 minutes.

🏷️ Jobber's offer, ends Oct 30: 30% off the first year on an annual plan, or 40% off the first 3 months paid monthly on an annual contract. Terms on Jobber's site. See the offer ↗

📅 What works with Jobber

Labels show how each tool connects

Jobber

Built in

Books jobs straight into your schedule using your Online Booking form, and can reschedule or cancel visits when you allow it.

💵 Core $29/mo billed annually ($49 monthly), Connect $99 ($139), Grow $149 ($199) for 1 user; extra users $29/mo; card fees 2.9% + 30¢.
Source: help.getjobber.com
Full review →Visit Jobber ↗

Smith.ai

Booking link

Receptionists book through your Jobber online booking link, which schedules and assigns the job in your calendar. Setup is done by emailing Smith.ai the link.

💵 Free: 25 calls/mo ($3/call after)
Source: smith.ai
Full review →Visit Smith.ai ↗

Dialzara

Via Zapier

Via Zapier: creates a Jobber request for each answered call. Calendar sync with Google or Outlook is on the Pro plan and up.

💵 From $29/mo (60 minutes); higher tiers from $99/mo
Source: zapier.com 1, dialzara.com 2
Full review →Visit Dialzara ↗

Rosie

Via Zapier

Via Zapier: creates a Jobber client from each call, and Zapier also offers find-or-create client and create job actions.

💵 Professional $49/mo (250 minutes); Scale $149/mo (1,000 minutes); Growth $299/mo (2,000 minutes)
Source: zapier.com
Full review →Visit Rosie ↗

Upfirst

Via Zapier

Via Zapier: Call Ended to Create Client, then Create Request. Upfirst books natively into Google, Outlook, Calendly, Acuity, Square and Clio, not Jobber.

💵 Starter $24.95/mo for 30 calls ($1.50 per extra call); Premium $59.95 (90 calls); Pro $159.95 (300 calls); Scale $299 (600 calls)
Source: upfirst.ai 1, upfirst.ai 2
Full review →Visit Upfirst ↗

⚠️ Zapier connections to Jobber need the Connect, Grow or Plus plan. Source: help.zapier.com

Questions people ask

Can an outside AI receptionist book directly into Jobber?Smith.ai can, through your Jobber online booking link. Rosie, Dialzara and Upfirst connect through Zapier, which creates clients, requests or jobs rather than picking a slot on your calendar.
Does Upfirst integrate natively with Jobber?No native integration. It connects through Zapier.
Is Zapier free?Zapier has a free plan; paid plans are priced by task volume. Check zapier.com for current limits.
